 Updated: 5:27 AM EST Nov 6, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Kelly Ann Cicalese Meteorologist BOSTON — Friday brings rain to Boston, with a StormTeam 5 Weather Alert in place. 
 Wet weather continues into the weekend with a few showers Saturday and a few lingering drops early Sunday. Monday turns breezy, followed by partly sunny skies Tuesday as temperatures settle closer to seasonal normals. Mostly sunny skies are expected for Veterans Day on Wednesday, with cool weather continuing Thursday.
 Advertisement StormTeam 5 tools: Radar | Map Room | Alerts | Futurecast 
 StormTeam 5's 7-day forecast:
 Friday: Rain. StormTeam 5 Weather Alert. High of 68°.
 Saturday: A few showers. High of 60°.
 Sunday: A few early drops, with clouds and sunshine. High of 57°.
 Monday: Partly sunny and breezy. High of 56°.
 Tuesday: Partly sunny. High of 59°.
 Wednesday: Mostly sunny for Veterans Day. High of 57°.
 Thursday: Partly sunny and cool. High of 55°.
